goal: Replace nested navigation into the legacy dashboard with a first-class video workspace in the standalone Dianchi Agent toolbox.

acceptance_criteria.description: Image and writing workspaces link to /video/ and no primary toolbox navigation links to the legacy /dashboard/ shell.
The standalone server serves a dedicated video workspace at /video/ while retaining /dashboard/ only as a compatibility route.

The video workspace mirrors the image workflow with adaptive preview, a bottom prompt and settings dock, and a persistent right-side video prompt assistant while retaining generation and download controls.
The video workspace does not persist API keys through localStorage or .env files.
The video prompt assistant compiles the source brief into three materially different, model-aware directions with distinct shot structures while preserving the source requirements.
The video workspace requests candidates from the standalone prompt compiler instead of cloning a browser-side sentence template.
The prompt compiler preserves long source constraints, uses explicit Seedance reference roles, and avoids multi-shot timecodes for short single-take requests.
Automatic prompt compilation prefers Codex OAuth semantic analysis and falls back to a local Prompt Pack when unavailable.
Dreamina 1080p generation selects a Seedance VIP model version that supports 1080p instead of the 720p-only fast model.
